spans.s:
रथ रथ, अस्, m. (according to some fr.
rt. 4. ऋ, according to Uṇādi-s.
II. 2

. fr. rt. रम्,
according to Nirukta
IX. 11

. fr. rt. रंह्), a two-
wheeled vehicle, carriage, car, chariot, war-chariot;
a vehicle or equipage in general, (applied also to the
vehicles of the gods; in Ved. applied sometimes to
the driver as well as the vehicle, but according to
Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

. रथ = रंहण-स्व-
[]
भाव, of a swift nature, going swiftly); a warrior,
hero, champion; the body; the foot; a limb, mem-
ber, part; Calamus Rotang; Dalbergia Ougeinensis;
= पौरुष; pleasure, delight, desire [cf. मनो-
रथ, रथ-जित्]; (ई), f. a small carriage; [cf.
probably Gr. ῤέθος; Lat. rota; Old Germ. rad;
Angl. Sax. rad, lidh; Goth. lithus; Lith. ratas;
Hib. roth.]
—रथ-कट्या or रथ-कड्या, f. a
quantity of chariots, assemblage of cars.
—रथ-
कर, अस्, m. = रथ-कार below.
—रथ-कल्-
पक, अस्, m. an officer who has charge of a king's
chariots, the arranger or superintendent of a great
man's equipages.
—रथ-काम्य, Nom. P. -काम्-
यति, &c., to long for a chariot, wish to be yoked
(said of a horse, &c.).
—रथ-काय, अम्, n. the
whole body or collection of chariots (constituting one
division of an army).
—रथ-कार or रथ-का-
रक, अस्, m. a chariot-maker, coach-builder, wheel-
wright, carpenter (regarded as the son of a Māhiṣya
by a Karaṇī).
—रथकार-त्व, अम्, n. the trade
or business of a carriage-builder.
—रथ-कुटुम्-
बिक, अस्, or रथ-कुटुम्बिन्, ई, m. a carriage-
driver, charioteer, coachman.
—रथ-कूबर, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a chariot-shaft, pole of a carriage.
—र-
थ-कृत्, त्, m. a carriage or chariot-maker, wheel-
wright (regarded as the son of a Māhiṣya by a
Karaṇī); N. of a Yakṣa.
—रथ-केतु, उस्, m. the
flag or banner of a chariot.
—रथ-क्रान्त, अस्,
m., N. of a particular time (in music).
—रथ-
क्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. purchased for the price of a
chariot.
—रथ-क्षय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abiding
or remaining in a chariot.
—रथ-क्षोभ, अस्,
m. the shaking about of a chariot.
—रथ-गणक,
अस्, m. ‘car-numberer,’ (probably) an officer who
numbers or counts a great man's chariots.
—रथ-
गर्भक, अस्, m. ‘an embryo-carriage,’ i. e. a litter,
sedan-chair, palanquin.
—रथ-गुप्ति, इस्, f. ‘car-
preservative,’ a fence of wood or iron protecting a
war-chariot from collisions, &c.
—रथ-गृत्स, अस्,
m., Ved. a clever or skilful charioteer.
—रथ-गो-
पन, अम्, n. = रथ-गुप्ति.
—रथ-ग्रन्थि, इस्,
m. the knot or fastening of a chariot.
—रथ-घो-
ष, अस्, m. the sound or rattling noise of a chariot.
—रथ-चक्र, अम्, n. a chariot-wheel.
—रथ-
चक्र-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. arranged in the form of a
chariot-wheel.
—रथ-चरण, अस्, m. ‘chariot-
foot,’ a chariot-wheel; the ruddy goose.
—रथ-
चर्या, f. chariot-course, chariot-exercise, chariot-race,
travelling or going by carriage, (frequently in pl.)
—रथ-चर्षण, Ved. a particular part of a
chariot, the middle part where people sit, (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
VIII. 5, 19

. रथ-चर्षणे
= रथस्य द्रष्टव्ये मध्ये देशे.)
—रथ-
चित्रा, f., N. of a river.
—रथ-जङ्घा, f. a par-
ticular part of a carriage, the hinder part.
—रथ-
जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. conquering chariots, obtaining
chariots by conquest; gaining desire, winning affec-
tion, (see रथ.)
—रथ-जूति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
rushing along in a chariot; (इस्), m. (perhaps) a
proper N.
—रथ-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge of
chariots, skill in driving.
—रथ-ज्ञानिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
skilled in managing a chariot, skilful in driving a
carriage.
—रथ-ज्वर, अस्, m. a crow.
—रथ-
तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved. urging a chariot, drawing a
carriage, (Sāy. Ṛg-veda

= रथस्य-प्रे-
रयितृ.)
—रथ-दारु, उ, n. wood suitable for
carriage building.
—रथ-द्रु, उस्, or रथ-द्रु-
म, अस्, m. Dalbergia Ougeinensis.
—रथ-धुर्,
ऊर्, f. the pole of a chariot, shaft of a carriage.
—रथ-धूर्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or standing
upon the fore-part of a chariot.
—रथ-नाभि, इस्,
f. the nave of a chariot-wheel.
—रथ-निर्घोष
or रथ-निर्ह्राद, अस्, m. the sound or rattling of
a chariot.
—रथ-निस्वन, अस्, m. sound of a
chariot.
—रथ-नीड, अस्, m. the seat or inner
part of a chariot.
—रथ-नेमि, इस्, f. the rim or
circumference of a chariot-wheel.
—रथन्-तर,
अम्, n. (रथम्, acc. c.), N. of various Sāmans;
(अस्), m. a form of Agni (regarded as a son of
Tapas); (ई), f., N. of a wife of Taṃsu.
—रथ-
पथ, अस्, m. a carriage road.
—रथ-पर्याय,
[]
अस्, m. Calamus Rotang.
—रथ-पाद, अस्, m.
‘carriage-foot,’ a carriage or chariot-wheel.
—रथ-
पुङ्गव, अस्, m. chief of warriors.
—रथ-प्रष्-
ठ, अस्, m. any one who goes before or leads a
chariot.
—रथ-प्रा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (according
to Sāy.) = रथस्य पूरयितृ, filling a chariot
(with riches, said of Vāyu); (आस्), f., N. of a river.
—रथ-प्रोत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fixed or fastened
in a car.
—रथ-प्रोष्ठ, अस्, m. a proper N.
—रथ-प्सा, आस्, f., N. of a river.
—रथ-बन्-
ध, अस्, m. ‘carriage-fastening,’ the fastenings or
harness of a chariot.
—रथ-मण्डल, अस्, अम्,
m. n. a number of chariots.
—रथ-मध्य-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, standing in the centre of a car.
—रथ-
महोत्सव, अस्, m. a great car-festival, the solemn
procession of an idol on a car.
—रथ-मुख, अम्,
n. the front or fore-part of a carriage.
—रथ-
यात्रा, f. ‘car-procession,’ the festive procession of
an idol on a car (especially the procession of the
car of Jagan-nātha).
—रथ-यान, अम्, n. the
going by carriage or in a chariot.
—रथ-यावन्,
आ, आ, अ, Ved. going by carriage or in a chariot.
—रथ-युग, अस्, m. a chariot yoke.
—रथ-
युज्, क्, क्, क्, yoking carriage, harnessed to chariots
(Ved.); (क्), m. a charioteer.
—रथ-युद्ध,
अम्, n. a chariot fight, a battle (between combatants
mounted) on chariots.
—रथ-यूथ, अस्, अम्, m.
n. a quantity or number of chariots.
—रथ-यो-
जक, अस्, m. the yoker or harnesser of a chariot.
—रथ-योध, अस्, m. one who fights from a
chariot.
—रथ-राज, अस्, m. ‘chariot-king,’ N. of
an ancestor of Śākya-muni.
—रथ-वंश, अस्, m.
a number of carriages.
—रथ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having or possessing carriages, accompanied with
chariots; containing the word रथ.
—रथ-वर,
अस्, m. an excellent chariot; excellent warrior.
—र-
थ-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. a carriage-road, highway, street.
—रथ-वाह, अस्, ई, अम्, drawing a carriage or
chariot; (अस्), m. a carriage-horse, a horse yoked in
a carriage; a coachman, charioteer.
—रथ-वा-
हक, अस्, m. a coachman, charioteer.
—रथ-वा-
हन, अस्, m. a proper N.; (अम्), n. a movable
platform or stand on which carriages may be placed.
—रथ-विज्ञान, अस्, m. or रथ-विद्या, f. skill
in managing chariots, the art of driving cars.
—र-
थ-विमोचन, अम्, n. the unyoking of a chariot.
—रथ-विमोचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the
unyoking of chariots.
—रथ-वीति, इस्, m., Ved. a
proper N.
—रथ-वीथी, f. a carriage way, high-
road, street.
—रथ-वेग, अस्, m. the speed or
velocity of a chariot.
—रथ-व्रज or रथ-
व्रात, अस्, m. = रथ-वंश.
—रथ-शक्ति, इस्,
f. the staff which supports the banner of a war-
chariot.
—रथ-शाला, f. a coach-house, carriage-
shed.
—रथ-शिक्षा, f. the art of driving a chariot,
coachmanship.
—रथ-शिरस्, अस्, or रथ-शीर्ष,
अम्, n., Ved. = रथ-मुख.
—रथ-श्रेणि, इस्,
f. a row of carriages, line of chariots.
—रथ-
सङ्ग, अस्, m. a hostile encounter of chariots.
—र-
थ-सत्तम, अस्, m. a most excellent chariot; the
best of warriors.
—रथ-सप्तमी, f., N. of the
seventh day in the light half of the month Māgha
(so called as the beginning of a Manvantara when a
new Sun ascended his car).
—रथ-सारथि, इस्, m.
a charioteer, coachman.
—रथ-सूत्र, अम्, n. rules
or directions about carriage building.
—रथ-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, being on a chariot, mounted on a car;
(आ), f., N. of a river.
—रथस्-पति, इस्, m. (रथस्
probably a form of the genitive; cf. वनस्-पति),
Ved. the deity presiding over pleasure (or over war-
chariots).
—रथ-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. touching the
chariot.
—रथ-स्वन, अस्, m. the sound or rattling
of chariots; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. having the sound of
a chariot (?), having a sounding chariot; (अस्), m.,
N. of a Yakṣa.
—रथाक्ष (˚थ-अक्˚), अस्, m. a
carriage axle; a measure of length, = 104 Aṅgulas;
N. of one of Skanda's attendants.
—रथाग्र्य (˚थ-
अग्˚), अस्, m. the best warrior, (sometimes incorrectly
written रथाग्र.)
—रथाङ्ग (˚थ-अङ्˚), अम्, n.
any part of a carriage, (in this sense also अस्, m.); a
carriage-wheel, chariot-wheel; a discus (especially
[]
that of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu); a potter's wheel or
lathe; (अस्), m. the ruddy goose, Anas Casarca, =
चक्र-वाक; (ई), f. a species of plant, = ऋद्धि;
(आ), f., see रथाह्वा.
—रथाङ्ग-तुल्याह्वयन
(˚य-आह्˚), अस्, m. ‘(a bird) having the same name
as the wheel of a carriage,’ i. e. the Anas Casarca
or ruddy goose (= चक्र-वाक).
—रथाङ्ग-ना-
मक, अस्, or रथाङ्ग-नामन्, आ, or रथाङ्ग-
सञ्ज्ञ, or रथाङ्ग-साह्व, or रथाङ्गाह्व (˚ग-
आह्˚), or रथाङ्गाह्वय (˚ग-आह्˚), अस्, m. = र-
थाङ्ग-तुल्याह्वयन above.
—रथाङ्ग-नेमि,
इस्, f. the circumference or felly of a chariot-wheel.
—रथाङ्ग-पाणि, इस्, m. ‘having a wheel, i. e. a
discus in hand,’ N. of Viṣṇu.
—रथाङ्ग-श्रोणि-
विम्बा, f. having buttocks like a wheel, i. e. semi-
circular.
—रथानीक (˚थ-अन्˚), अम्, n. an array
or army of war-chariots.
—रथान्तर (˚थ-अन्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a preceptor, (for रथीतर); N. of a
Kalpa.
—रथाभ्र (˚थ-अभ्˚) or रथाभ्र-
पुष्प, अस्, m. Calamus Rotang.
—रथा-रथि,
ind. (fr. रथ + रथ), carriage to carriage, chariot
against chariot, in closest fight; [cf. नखा-नखि.]
—रथारूढ (˚थ-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on
a chariot.
—रथारोह (˚थ-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sit-
ting or mounted on a chariot, one who fights from
a chariot; (अस्), m. the mounting or ascending a
chariot, entering a carriage.
—रथारोहिन् (˚थ-
आर्˚), ई, इणी, इ, mounting a car, one who rides on or
fights from a chariot.
—रथार्भक (˚थ-अर्˚),
अस्, m. a small carriage.
—रथा-वट्ट, अस्, m. a
proper N.
—रथावयव (˚थ-अव्˚), अस्, m. any
part or portion of a carriage.
—रथावर्त (˚थ-
आव्˚), अस्, m., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
—र-
थाश्व (˚थ-अश्˚), अस्, m. a carriage or chariot-
horse; (अम्), n. a carriage and horse.
—रथा-सह्,
औ, m. du., Ved. able or fit to draw a chariot (said
of the two horses of Vāyu).
—रथाहर् (˚थ-अह्˚)
or रथाह्न (˚थ-अह्˚) or रथाह्न्य, अम्, n.,
Ved. a day by carriage or chariot, a day's journey by
carriage.
—रथाह्वा (˚थ-आह्˚), f., N. of a river,
(also read रथाङ्का, रथाङ्गा.)
—रथे-चित्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. variegated or glittering on a
chariot.
—रथेश (˚थ-ईश), अस्, m. the owner or
master of a carriage, a warrior or combatant fighting
from a chariot; (आ), f. the pole of a carriage, (for
the next.)
—रथेषा (˚थ-ईषा), f. the pole or
shaft of a carriage, chariot-pole.
—रथेषु (˚थ-
इषु), उस्, m., N. of a kind of arrow.
—रथे-
ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing on a car or chariot,
moving or going by carriage, a warrior or combatant
fighting from a chariot; [cf. Zend rathœstā.]
—रथोढ (˚थ-ऊढ) or रथोऌह, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. carried on a chariot or carriage.
—रथोत्तम
(˚थ-उत्˚), अस्, m. an excellent chariot or carriage.
—रथोत्सव (˚थ-उत्˚), अस्, m. the car-festival, a
solemn procession of an idol mounted on a car.
—रथोद्धत (˚थ-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
haughty on his car; (आ), f., N. of a kind of metre,
four times ¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯; N. of a work.
—रथोद्वह (˚थ-उद्˚) or रथोपस्थ (˚थ-
उप्˚), अस्, m. the seat of a chariot, seat for driving,
driving-box (as lower than the main body of the car),
the hinder part of a car.
—रथोरग (˚थ-उर्˚), आस्,
m. pl., N. of a people.
—रथोष्मा (˚थ-उष्˚),
f., N. of a river.
—रथौघ (˚थ-ओघ), अस्, m.
a number of carriages or chariots.
—रथौजस्
(˚थ-ओज्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having the strength of a
chariot, as strong as a chariot.
रथक, अस्, m. a particular part of a house.
रथया, f., Ved. desire for carriages or chariots.

रथयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring or wishing for
carriages.

रथर्य, Nom. P. रथर्यति, &c., Ved. to go
or travel by carriage or chariot.
रथर्वी, f., Ved. epithet of a serpent.
रथस्या, f., N. of a river.

रथिक, अस्, ई, अम्, going by carriage or chariot,
any one who travels or rides in a carriage, the owner
of a car or carriage.

रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, equipped or furnished with a
chariot.

रथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or possessing a chariot
or carriage, going in a car, travelling or riding in
a carriage; consisting of chariots; accustomed to
chariots (said of horses, Ved.); belonging to car-
riages; (ई), m. an owner of a carriage, lord of
chariots; a warrior who fights from a chariot; (इनी),
f. a number of carriages or chariots.

रथिन, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing a carriage, riding
in a chariot.

रथिर, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing a carriage or
chariot, going in a carriage; hastening, quick,
speedy; (अस्), m. a warrior.

रथिराय, Nom. P. रथिरायति, &c., Ved. to
go quickly, hasten; (Sāy.) to possess a chariot.

रथिरायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. hastening; having
chariots.

रथी (a Vedic word formed fr. रथ, and used
as both adj. and subst.; रथ्यम् acc. sing., रथ्यस्
acc. pl.), one going by chariot, one who is furnished
with a chariot or carriage; forming a cart-load, as
much as a cart will carry, carried on a waggon, be-
longing to a chariot; a carriage-driver, coachman,
charioteer, a warrior who fights from a chariot; a
guide, leader, master, lord.
—रथी-तम, अस्, m.,
Ved. chief or best of charioteers, (Sāy. = अतिशयेन
रथिन् or अतिशयेन रंहितृ.)
—रथी-तर, अस्,
आ, अम्, a better or superior charioteer; (अस्), m., N.
of a preceptor; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants.
रथीकर, अस्, m. a proper N.

रथीय, Nom. P. रथीयति, &c., to desire a
chariot; to go or travel in a chariot.

रथीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring a chariot;
going in a chariot.

रथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to a
carriage or chariot, accustomed to a carriage; delight-
ing in roads (?); (अस्), m. a carriage or chariot-horse,
(also आ, f.); a part of a chariot; (आ), f. a road for
carriages, high-road, main road, a place where several
roads meet; a number of carriages or chariots, assem-
blage of cars; (अम्), n., Ved. carriage equipments
or harness, chariot trappings, a wheel or any part
of a carriage; (perhaps) a chariot-race or contest
with chariots; a conveyance, carriage (?).
—रथ्य-
चर्या, f. = रथ-चर्या, q. v.
—रथ्यावसर्पण
(˚या-अव्˚), अम्, n. walking down a road.
—रथ्यो-
पसर्पण (˚या-उप्˚), अम्, n. walking to a road.

राथ्य, अस्, आ (?), अम्, belonging to a chariot, fit
for a chariot, useful for a carriage; = रथ्य (of which
it is a lengthened form, Ṛg-veda

राथकारिक राथकारिक (fr. रथ-कार),
see Gaṇa Kumudādi 2. to Pāṇ.

राथकार्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Ratha-
kāra.

राथगणक, अम्, n. the occupation or office of
a Ratha-gaṇaka.
